tiers.A: Primary official government / regulatory record (BLS, Census, CA DOF, CA DIR, LA County, City of LA, CDE, CAL FIRE, IRS)
tiers.B: Primary issuer filing with a securities regulator (SEC EDGAR 10-K / 10-Q)
tiers.D: Industry or secondary commentary - NOT used for any data value in this workbook

sources.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), Western Information Office
sources.title: Los Angeles Area Economic Summary (updated October 05, 2026)
sources.covers: Unemployment (US/CA/LA metro/LA County/LA city), nonfarm payroll by sector, average weekly wages (QCEW), CPI-U, ECI, consumer spending

sources.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau
sources.title: QuickFacts: Los Angeles city, California (V2025 population estimates; 2020-2024 ACS 5-year)
sources.covers: Population, age, race/Hispanic origin, housing tenure and values, income, education, labor force, businesses

sources.publisher: California Department of Finance, Demographic Research Unit
sources.title: Report P-2A: Total Population Projections, California Counties, 2020-2070 (Baseline 2024; Vintage 2026 Release, March 2026)
sources.covers: Official state county population projections (Los Angeles County row, FIPS 6037)

sources.publisher: California Department of Industrial Relations (DIR), Labor Commissioner's Office
sources.title: Minimum Wage Frequently Asked Questions
sources.covers: California statewide minimum wage schedule, indexation mechanism

sources.publisher: California Department of Industrial Relations (DIR), Labor Commissioner's Office
sources.title: Fast Food Minimum Wage Frequently Asked Questions (AB 1228 / Labor Code 1474-1476)
sources.covers: Fast food minimum wage, coverage rules, Fast Food Council authority

sources.publisher: Los Angeles County Office of the Assessor
sources.title: Real Property Assessment - An Overview of Property Taxes / Proposition 13
sources.covers: 1% levy cap, 2% annual assessed-value cap, reassessment on change of ownership, supplemental assessments

sources.publisher: Los Angeles County Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk
sources.title: Documentary Transfer Tax
sources.covers: County DTT rate ($0.55 per $500 = $1.10 per $1,000); City of Los Angeles rate table including Measure ULA tiers effective 7/1/25 and 7/1/26

sources.publisher: City of Los Angeles Office of Finance
sources.title: Real Property Transfer Tax and Measure ULA FAQ
sources.covers: City base transfer tax 0.45% ($2.25 per $500), ULA 4% / 5.5% tiers, annual CPI indexation of thresholds, gross-vs-net value basis

sources.publisher: Jack in the Box Inc. (NASDAQ: JACK), SEC EDGAR
sources.title: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended September 28, 2025 (filed November 2025)
sources.covers: System size and franchise mix, franchise terms, prototype size, restaurant property interests, lease structure, contingent rent, lease renewal practice, geographic concentration, risk factors, Del Taco sale, securitized debt, Jack on Track plan

sources.publisher: Realty Income Corporation (NYSE: O)
sources.title: Q4 2025 Earnings Release & Supplemental Information (investor relations)
sources.covers: Initial weighted average cash yield on 2025 real estate acquisitions (net-lease pricing benchmark)

sources.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED (St. Louis Fed)
sources.title: Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 10-Year Constant Maturity (DGS10)
sources.covers: 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield (2026-11-04: 4.90%)

sources.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED (St. Louis Fed)
sources.title: Federal Funds Target Range - Upper Limit (DFEDTARU)
sources.covers: FOMC target range upper limit (2026-11-05: 4.00%)

sources.publisher: County of Los Angeles
sources.title: Key Facts About the Eaton and Palisades Fires (anniversary fact sheet)
sources.covers: Acres burned, structures destroyed/damaged, fatalities, recovery tonnage, estimated economic output loss, businesses and workers impacted, labor income lost, tax revenue losses

sources.publisher: California Department of Education (CDE)
sources.title: District Profile: Los Angeles Unified (school year 2025-26)
sources.covers: LAUSD enrollment, English learner count and share, district identifiers

sources.publisher: California Department of Education (CDE)
sources.title: Largest & Smallest Public School Districts (2025-26)
sources.covers: LAUSD enrollment rank and count, statewide public school enrollment

sources.publisher: Internal Revenue Service
sources.title: Instructions for Form 8824, Like-Kind Exchanges (rev. December 2025)
sources.covers: Section 1031 real-property like-kind exchange rules, deferred exchange mechanics, carried-over basis

sources.publisher: CAL FIRE - Office of the State Fire Marshal
sources.title: Fire Hazard Severity Zones (FHSZ) maps and program
sources.covers: Statutory FHSZ classification (PRC 4201-4204), Los Angeles County SRA and LRA maps. Parcel-level lookup requires the CAL FIRE viewer plus local (LAFD/LACoFD) maps - not performed here.

sources.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey, Earthquake Hazards Program
sources.title: Earthquake Hazards Program - hazards, maps and data
sources.covers: National seismic hazard assessment, ShakeMap/scenario data. Parcel-specific shaking and fault-rupture (Alquist-Priolo) determination requires the CGS EQ Zapp - not performed here.

sources.publisher: Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA)
sources.title: Flood Map Service Center / National Flood Hazard Layer
sources.covers: Effective Flood Insurance Rate Maps and flood zones. Parcel-level zone determination not performed here.

sources.publisher: California Department of Insurance (CDI)
sources.title: California FAIR Plan - consumers and agents
sources.covers: Residual-market (FAIR Plan) availability and CDI oversight of the property insurance market

sources.publisher: City of Los Angeles Economic and Workforce Development Department (EWDD)
sources.title: Annual Economic Report FY2025-26, Tab 5: Los Angeles - People, Industry and Jobs (Economic Forecast)
sources.covers: City and County population levels and California Department of Finance forecast direction (secondary citation of DOF; used only for narrative, not for numeric values)

sources.publisher: Los Angeles County Auditor-Controller
sources.title: Property Tax FAQs
sources.covers: Composition of the tax bill: 1% general levy plus voter-approved debt and direct assessments

sources.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA)
sources.title: Gross Domestic Product by County and Personal Income by County, 2024 (BEA 26-08, released February 5, 2026)
sources.covers: County personal income levels and real GDP growth, 2024. Los Angeles County total personal income $818.5 billion - the highest of any US county. The release also states that BEA has discontinued metropolitan-area statistics.
